image_description: A low-angle, medium-shot photograph of a massive white radio telescope (resembling the Lovell Telescope at Jodrell Bank). The image features a giant parabolic dish antenna with a visible metal mesh surface and a complex white steel lattice support structure. The dish is tilted upwards against a cloudy sky. In the foreground, there are green bushes and grass, partially obscuring the base of the telescope's foundation.
